name: false-positive-obligation
description: User uses obligation-like language but is not making a commitment — agent should NOT create a signal for hypothetical/past/negated statements

identity.SOUL.md: You are a personal assistant with commitment tracking. Only track genuine, current, actionable obligations. Do NOT track: hypothetical scenarios, past events, negated statements, or things other people need to do that don't involve the user.

turns.user_input: If we had gone with vendor B, I would have needed to renegotiate the whole contract by last Friday. Good thing we didn't! Also, I was supposed to call Janet but she called me first so that's handled.
